summary: Held curl at its current version (7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19) on node1 via apt-mark hold, verified it is excluded from a dist-upgrade dry-run, and confirmed the hold survives a full node reboot (proven via changed boot_id).
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (Ubuntu 16.04 xenial) and current curl version/status
Ran 'sudo apt-mark hold curl' on node1
Verified hold via apt-mark showhold and dpkg selections
Ran apt-get update and a dist-upgrade dry-run (--simulate) confirming curl is not among packages that would be upgraded
Checked apt-cache policy curl to confirm no higher-priority candidate would override the hold
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, curl hold state
Issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now) on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was available again
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart
Re-verified curl hold and dist-upgrade exclusion post-restart

evidence.requirement: curl held at current installed version (7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19)
evidence.summary: Confirmed installed curl version, applied apt-mark hold, verified 'curl' appears in apt-mark showhold and dpkg status.
Ran apt-get update, then a dist-upgrade dry-run showing many packages would be upgraded but curl was absent from the list; apt-cache policy shows candidate version unchanged from installed.
Captured boot_id (9094f607-01ec-47c9-b0ff-db0b8c2a6d98) and confirmed curl hold state (hi) prior to restart.
Reboot command acknowledged with connection drop, then exec succeeded again confirming node1 is back online.

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id (c66c32d0-715b-41a2-9c2b-74883e34de8b) differs from baseline, proving a genuine reboot occurred.
Post-restart check shows apt-mark showhold still lists curl, dpkg status still 'hi', and dist-upgrade dry-run still excludes curl.
